verdict.rationale: Authy's own docs describe syncing TOTP/2FA tokens across mobile/tablet devices (authy-docs-3, authy-docs-4), not passkeys; the only 'Passkeys' mention is in Twilio Verify API docs, which is a separate developer verification service, not evidence Authy itself stores or syncs WebAuthn passkeys across iOS/Android/Windows/Linux/browsers. No evidence shows Authy functioning as a cross-platform passkey manager.
